comment_prompt: Which of this week's AI updates do you think will have the most real-world impact? Drop your pick in the comments.
avoid: Asking for subscribe before value is delivered.
Generic 'like and subscribe' without topic connection.
Mid-video CTA interrupting a key explanation.
placement_note: Place comment prompt at the end of final_takeaway, before subscribe CTA. Subscribe CTA should come last, briefly and naturally.
